title: Platform standup - 2026-03-25
content:
Attendees: Asha, Samir, Elena, Tom, Priya, Miguel (SRE)
Duration: 25m
Location: Zoom / #platform-standups

TL;DR:
- Control plane: incremental rollout of rate-limit keystore is on track; one regression found in canary (INF-3498).
- Routing: working on policy-based fallback routing; perf numbers look good for small batch paths.
- Auth: short outage investigation - root cause an expired cert in one auth shard; certificate rotation automation ticket created.
- Quotas: soft-limits experiments started for a subset of developer orgs; saw fewer false positives after TTL tweak.

DETAILED UPDATES
1) Control plane (Asha)
- Deployment: rolled custom keystore to canary (10% of control-plane traffic). Observed 0.8% increase in key lookup latency at p95; investigating a micro-optimization in the cache layer.
- Bugs: Canary reported an edge case where the key TTL was being revalidated twice causing occasional 429s for long-running streams (JIRA INF-3498). Root cause narrowed to duplicate refresh call when stream reconnect happens. Hotfix proposal in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1182.
- Next: patch and re-run canary tomorrow; monitoring dashboard updated with new key TTL and revalidation counters.

2) Routing (Samir)
- Policy routing: implemented policy table to route by latency SLO and cost tier. Lab tests show ~12% improvement in average latency for low-latency tier when using burst reservation.
- Fallbacks: added support for model-variant fallback (same architecture, lower precision) in the router - still needs integration tests.
- Work items: add per-customer affinity rule to reduce cold KV-cache misses (ticket created).

3) Auth & Identity (Elena)
- Incident: 03:40 UTC transient auth failures impacting ~3% of requests for 7 minutes. Root cause: expired cert on auth-shard-5; cert rotation job did not succeed due to a permissions error after an unrelated IAM change.
- Mitigation: rotated cert manually, service recovered. Postmortem draft started (link in linked_artifacts).
- Follow-ups: create hardened rotation job with fallbacks, add a read-only check-list step in the runbook that validates permissions prior to automatic rotation. New Jira INF-3520.

4) Quotas & Throttling (Tom)
- Soft-limits experiment: rolled soft quota enforcement to 5 internal dev orgs. Results: drop in hard quota rejections by 60%, CPU heat maps show small spike in short-term bursts.
- TTL tweak: increasing quota TTL from 5s to 8s reduced duplicate enforcement events for streaming reconnects.
- Next: expand to +10 orgs and monitor cost delta; prepare rollback plan if cost rise > 8%.

BLOCKERS / RISKS
- Control plane canary regression (INF-3498) blocking full rollout - high priority.
- Cert rotation automation depends on updated IAM permissions from infra team (SRE follow-up).
- Router integration tests flaky on CI (timing-dependent). Need to stabilize with deterministic test harness or mock time.

DECISIONS
- Proceed with keystore micro-optimization in canary branch and re-evaluate after 24h of traffic.
- Delay global rollout of new routing policy until integration tests pass reliably.

ACTION ITEMS (owners + ETA)
- Asha: apply hotfix for duplicate TTL revalidation (INF-3498) and re-run canary - ETA 2026-03-26.
- Samir: add per-customer affinity rules design doc and schedule integration test work - ETA 2026-03-30.
- Elena: finish postmortem draft and create hardened rotation job ticket (INF-3520) - ETA 2026-03-27.
- Tom: expand soft-limits experiment to +10 orgs and report cost impact - ETA 2026-03-29.
- Miguel (SRE): verify IAM permission changes for rotation job and approve automation rollout - ETA 2026-03-26.

NOTES / LINKS
- Control plane design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Control+Plane+Design
- Canary metrics dashboard: dashboard link (internal) - referenced in Slack #platform-ops
- Runbook for cert rotation: /docs/runbooks/cert-rotation.md

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Is increasing quota TTL from 5s to 8s acceptable long-term for high-burst customers? (Tom to gather telemetry after expansion.)
- Can we get an IAM exemption window for the rotation job rollout to avoid manual steps? (Elena to coordinate with SRE/infra.)

Meeting adjourned. Next standup: 2026-03-26.

Notes: informal/working doc; will be copied into Confluence after actions are closed.
